notes.title: Put your name in the credits of Yume No Office
notes.content:
If you want to immortalize your nickname or name in the credits of Yume No Office, this is your chance.  

Simply join our Discord and post a screenshot of your Steam library showing the game.  

Spots are limited.  

Additionally, there are stretch goals depending on the sales the game reaches before the release of Chapters 2 and 3.  

Including a free update with adult content.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120841/936d4010f121ea95beb2ecc63f2bb89d901e953a.png  

We’ll be waiting for you on our Discord.

notes.title: Yume No Office chapters 2 and 3 have gone into production.
notes.content:
With over 100 units in circulation, Chapters 2 and 3 are now entering production. We want to thank everyone for your reviews and the love you've shown throughout the creative process. Here’s what we have planned for this upcoming update (these features may change or increase, so this is just an estimate):

• 9 new expressions for the half-body sprites  
• 2 new outfits for the protagonists  
• 15 CG artworks  
• 25 new events  
• 2 new poses for each half-body sprite  
• At least 15 more backgrounds  
• 15 new special artworks  
• 15 new songs

All of this is planned for late 2025.

Additionally, we will be adding an extended demo that will be available to those who have the project on their Wishlist. There is no set date yet, but we hope to release it before the end of the year.
